evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Declarative 'we shipped' carries energized accomplishment — high arousal, positive valence in the act of announcing a completed deliverable.
Superlative delivered in a measured, factual register — satisfaction with the result without energized delivery; low arousal, positive valence.
'Key unlock' frames the integration as a breakthrough moment — energized positive valuation, high arousal in the metaphor of release and discovery.
